ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across central and proximal regions, with localized high-intensity (white/light grey) patches covering approximately 15-20% of the visible surface area at the distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity blob on the distal end of the left lobe extending from the leading edge to the trailing edge; a narrower, elongated high-intensity band on the distal end of the right lobe; central region is a solid low-intensity mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 50-60 degrees, centered at the vertical axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across both lobes; left lobe shows a significant deep indentation approximately two-thirds from the center; right lobe shows more uniform, smaller-amplitude scalloping.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly downward-tilted points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (diameters <1% of lobe width) concentrated within the high-intensity white patch on the left distal lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, near-parallel dark linear streaks oriented diagonally on the left lobe white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe, significantly deeper than the surrounding serration peaks.
other_distinctive_markers: One large, isolated dark circular spot (approx. 3% of lobe width) located centrally within the white pigment region of the left lobe.
